summary: Luke Badiali led a campaign session with Thomas Avery and Grace Lindqvist. Brookvale has published almost nothing in the last year despite strong sector knowledge. We agreed a campaign plan built on the quarterly sector briefings, Thomas's profile with deal partners and the sanitised deal library from week 2.

discussion.keyPoints: Grace found two articles and one webinar in 12 months. Thomas said the team is always on billable work and content slips.
Luke suggested Thomas writes a monthly note on what IC committees are asking in each sector. Thomas agreed in principle but wanted Grace to draft.
Grace asked how to judge whether content leads to mandates, given deal partners rarely say how they heard of Brookvale.

recommendations.recommendation: Run one campaign per sector per year, starting with healthcare services in Q1.
Thomas to publish a monthly 'what ICs are asking' note on LinkedIn, drafted by Grace.
Hire a part-time sector writer at around 3k a month.
Turn five deal library entries into two-page case summaries for pitch packs.
Ask every new deal partner how they heard of Brookvale and log it in the CRM.

actions.action: Draft the first 'what ICs are asking' note on healthcare services

nextFocus: Develop partnerships with intermediaries and complementary advisers.
nextPreparation: Thomas to list the advisers Brookvale has worked alongside on deals.

tests.question: Is hiring a sector writer agreed?
